Subject: Executive workshop — self check-in kiosk and ambient room preferences

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for confirming the block with Brightwater for your Sept 14-16 executive workshop. A few operational items for the run of show that we can action once we have details from your team: 

- Self check-in kiosk: we can deploy a single unattended kiosk in the lobby (near the concierge desk) with a badge-scan option, or two kiosks (arrival peak) if you expect staggered waves. See attached kiosk_flow.pdf for the UI and placement options.
- Ambient room preferences: we can preset rooms for light level, white-noise machine, fridge contents, and pillow type on a per-guest basis if you provide a preferences file.
- Pre-staged keycards: we offer pre-staged keycards for groups arriving in a 2-hour window to speed check-in.
- Accessible check-in: we have an ADA counter and a mobile check-in attendant on call. Please flag any attendees with mobility or service-animal requirements.
- Master bill and tax details: attach masterbill_template.xlsx with the billing codes we need to finalize. We can also set up a tax-exempt cover if you provide the certificate.

If you can send a short arrival window per flight or attendee and indicate whether you want single or dual kiosks, we can lock in deployment and logistics by Friday.

Attached: kiosk_flow.pdf, masterbill_template.xlsx

Best,
Sara Miller
Senior Sales Manager
Brightwater Hotels

Attached is the rooming_preferences_form.docx — please confirm you can import this CSV-style layout into your PMS and set pillow preferences (feather / hypoallergenic), mini-fridge stock (regular / none), and ambient lighting (standard / dimmed).

> - Pre-staged keycards: we offer pre-staged keycards for groups arriving in a 2-hour window to speed check-in.

Yes, please pre-stage keycards for everyone arriving 1:00pm-3:30pm. Label by last name and team.

Note: we have one attendee (Markus Klein) who uses a power scooter and needs a ground-floor accessible room and an accessible path to the plenary room. cc'ing Marissa to flag to Ops.

Also request confirmation that minibar (if used) will be billed to folio vs. master bill — we prefer room charges remain on individual folios and only F&B and meeting room rental on the master bill.

Thanks — can you confirm receiving the attached form and the two-kiosk plan?

Cheers,
